text: though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow
blank: though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as ___
gloss: 罪雖如朱紅，仍可洗淨如雪，喻徹底的赦免與潔淨
usage: 現代英語仍引用 white as snow 比喻徹底洗淨、恢復純潔無瑕的狀態

text: beat their swords into plowshares
blank: they shall beat their swords into ___
gloss: 化劍為犁，喻放棄戰爭、追求和平
usage: 現代英語極常引用 beat swords into plowshares 表達化干戈為玉帛、將軍事資源轉為民生用途的理念

text: call evil good, and good evil
blank: woe to those who call evil good, and good ___
gloss: 顛倒是非、混淆善惡
usage: 現代英語（尤其政治、道德評論）常引用 call evil good and good evil 批評顛倒是非的言論或行為

text: Here am I. Send me!
blank: Then I said, 'Here am ___. Send me!'
gloss: 自願挺身而出、接受使命
usage: 現代英語常引用 here am I, send me 表達自願承擔使命或挺身而出的心志

text: people who walked in darkness have seen a great light
blank: the people who walked in darkness have seen a great ___
gloss: 在黑暗中的人見到了大光，喻絕望中出現希望
usage: 現代英語仍引用 people who walked in darkness have seen a great light 形容絕境中出現的希望或轉機

text: Prince of Peace
blank: his name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of ___
gloss: 和平之君，促成和平的領袖人物
usage: 現代英語常用 Prince of Peace 稱呼致力於和平、化解衝突的領袖人物

text: the wolf will live with the lamb
blank: the wolf will live with the ___
gloss: 狼與羊同居，喻天敵和睦共處、衝突化解
usage: 現代英語常引用 the wolf shall lie down with the lamb 比喻原本敵對的雙方和睦共處

text: let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die
blank: let's eat and drink, for tomorrow we will ___
gloss: 及時行樂，因為明天將面對死亡
usage: 現代英語極常引用 eat, drink, for tomorrow we die 表達及時行樂、把握當下的態度

text: wipe away tears from off all faces
blank: the Lord GOD will wipe away ___ from off all faces
gloss: 擦去所有的眼淚，喻終結一切悲傷苦難
usage: 現代英語常引用 wipe away every tear 表達終結悲傷、帶來徹底安慰的承諾

text: Comfort, comfort my people
blank: 'Comfort, comfort my ___,' says your God
gloss: 安慰、安慰我的百姓，喻傳遞安慰與希望的信息
usage: 現代英語（尤其音樂、文學語境，韓德爾《彌賽亞》開篇即引用此節）常用 comfort ye my people 表達傳遞安慰的信息

text: the voice of one who calls out in the wilderness
blank: the voice of one who calls out, 'Prepare the way of the LORD in the ___!'
gloss: 曠野中的呼聲，喻為重大事件預先發出的呼籲或警告
usage: 現代英語常引用 a voice crying in the wilderness 形容不被重視卻極重要的先聲或警告（新約引用此節描述施洗約翰）

text: all flesh is like grass
blank: all flesh is like ___, and all its glory is like the flower of the field
gloss: 人生短暫如草，喻生命的脆弱無常
usage: 現代英語（尤其文學、悼詞語境）仍引用 all flesh is grass 感嘆生命的短暫無常

text: mount up with wings like eagles
blank: they will mount up with wings like ___
gloss: 如鷹展翅上騰，喻在等候中重獲力量、超越困境
usage: 現代英語常引用 mount up with wings as eagles 鼓勵人在等候中重獲新力量、突破困境

text: how beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news
blank: how beautiful on the mountains are the ___ of him who brings good news
gloss: 傳好消息之人的腳蹤何等佳美，喻捎來好消息者備受歡迎
usage: 現代英語（尤其宗教與勵志語境）仍引用 how beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news 讚頌傳遞佳音者

text: by his wounds we are healed
blank: by his ___ we are healed
gloss: 因他受的傷我們得醫治，喻代人受苦帶來的救贖
usage: 現代英語廣泛引用 by his wounds we are healed 或 wounded for our transgressions 表達替代性犧牲帶來的救贖或療癒

text: all we like sheep have gone astray
blank: all we like sheep have gone ___
gloss: 我們都如羊走迷，各人偏行己路，喻人人都曾犯錯迷失
usage: 現代英語常引用 all we like sheep have gone astray 形容人人都曾誤入歧途、需要被引導回正軌

text: like a lamb that is led to the slaughter
blank: as a lamb that is led to the ___
gloss: 像羊羔被牽去宰殺，喻無辜受害卻默然承受
usage: 現代英語極常引用 like a lamb to the slaughter 形容毫無防備、無辜地走向危險或傷害

text: my thoughts are not your thoughts
blank: my thoughts are not your ___
gloss: 我的意念非同你們的意念，喻更高層次的智慧超乎人的理解
usage: 現代英語常引用 my thoughts are not your thoughts 表達某種智慧或安排超乎常人理解

text: my word...will not return to me void
blank: my word...will not return to me ___
gloss: 我的話不會徒然返回，喻承諾或言語必然產生果效
usage: 現代英語仍引用 my word shall not return void 表達說出的話或承諾必定會實現、產生效果

text: Repairer of the Breach
blank: you will be called ___ of the Breach
gloss: 修補破口的人，喻致力於修復關係或制度破裂的人
usage: 現代英語（尤其領導、和解語境）常引用 repairer of the breach 稱呼致力修復裂痕、重建關係的人

text: bind up the brokenhearted
blank: he has sent me to bind up the ___
gloss: 醫治傷心的人，喻撫慰痛苦、破碎的心靈
usage: 現代英語仍用 bind up the brokenhearted 形容撫慰、醫治心靈創傷的行動

text: proclaim liberty to the captives
blank: to proclaim ___ to the captives
gloss: 向被擄的宣告自由，喻爭取解放與自由的宣言
usage: 現代英語（此句也刻在美國自由鐘上）常引用 proclaim liberty throughout the land 表達爭取自由解放的宣言

text: new heavens and a new earth
blank: I create new heavens and a new ___
gloss: 新天新地，喻徹底更新、脫胎換骨的嶄新開始
usage: 現代英語廣泛引用 new heavens and a new earth 表達徹底革新、開創嶄新局面的願景
